tldr: the Sun through the 12th house brings attention to rest, retreat, privacy, hidden pressure, and endings.
body:
When the Sun moves through your 12th house, it brings attention to rest, retreat, privacy, hidden pressure, exhaustion, endings, and what you are not ready to explain. You may notice what is happening out of sight: fatigue, unfinished feelings, private pressure, or the need to step back before you can understand what comes next.

Something may feel more visible, energizing, exposed, or ready to be claimed. It can help you notice what needs more life, honesty, or direct attention.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for giving yourself space to process what cannot be solved by pushing harder.

The caution: Watch for needing validation so badly that you miss what actually feels true. The risk is disappearing into avoidance when what you really need is rest, honesty, and quiet support.

The Sun moves through this house for about a month. Use the visibility well. Put attention where it gives you more life, not just more approval.
